neighbor.input: one sign(e) step per nonzero K3 sample, independent of abs(e)

K3_precedence.result: encoder drained before normal K3 dispatch

K3_precedence.boundary: Settings/SOUND row edits remain incumbent owned

K3_precedence.when: V_SEQ and canonical part2/3 and ui.held_step>=0
K3_precedence.result: held melodic step velocity+=e, clamp1..127; step_edited=1; mark_dirty; refresh existing preview
one clamped neighbor; cancel bass/drum step hooks only if canonical part changes; assign part; V_GEN to non-synth falls back V_PART; outline invalid; rebuild pages

K3_precedence.when: resulting view V_MIX after normal part branch, including clamped same part

K3_non_overrides: A held V_PART melodic step does not cause velocity edit
A held V_SEQ drum step does not cause melodic velocity edit
Normal K3 part selection does not directly edit sound or clear all page memories
Do not infer all-notes-off/panic from the named step-cancel hooks

page_storage.part_key: canonical part ID, not presentation index or engine kind
page_storage.ordinary_rebuild: build_pages resets stored out-of-range page to0
page_storage.SOUND_interface: Existing admitted SOUND descriptor follows the new final row; asynchronous bank-layout flags preserve the source interface. No new CP1 implementation or policy is specified.
page_storage.init_lifecycle: ui_init zeros session UI/page memory and starts canonical909 V_SEQ; ordinary navigation does not

set_view.destination_page: restore page_of(destination) subject to descriptor normalization
set_view.held_PART_to_SEQ: ui.held_step>=0 or ui.hold_step>=0 => RELEASE STEP FIRST; stay in PART
set_view.held_SEQ_to_PART: retain bass/drum held step for p-lock route
other_changes: prev_view update only if actual view changes

same_view_page_buttons.PARA: if already V_PART/O_NONE, increment modulo full page count; pending-SOUND cancel exception reserved
same_view_page_buttons.SEQ: if already V_SEQ/O_NONE, increment modulo sequence descriptor count
same_view_page_buttons.FX: if already V_FX/O_NONE, increment modulo FX descriptor count
same_view_page_buttons.NOTE REPEAT: if already V_MIX/O_NONE, increment modulo mixer descriptor count

header_identity.compact_lane_names: JUN/CHI/MIA, or JU-A/JU-B,CH-A/CH-B,MI-A/MI-B when same engine in both slots
header_identity.unknown_unavailable_boundary: Not selected here. Consume incumbent source/CP1 availability contract; no automatic substitution or renumbering. Drone active design withdrawn.
